Link in-text to a bibliography entry, with a round-trip backlink

Source: R/bib-core.R
bib_cite_link.Rd

Produces an HTML anchor pointing down to the entry key (rendered by bib_html_list() with id = key), and carries its own id so that entry can link back up to this exact citing location. Pass the same id(s) via cited_at in bib_html_list() to get a live "up" link on the entry; use a distinct id for a second citation of the same key (e.g. paste0("cite-", key, "-2")) and list both under that key in cited_at.

Usage

bib_cite_link(key, label = key, id = paste0("cite-", key))

Arguments

key

Bibliography entry key to link to.

label

Visible link text; defaults to key.

id

Anchor id for this citing location; defaults to paste0("cite-", key).

Value

A character vector of HTML strings, the same length as key.
